summary.en-US: Right-click any image or video and save it as animated WebP, WebP, AVIF, GIF, MP4 and more. You set the rules and the quality. Everything converts on your computer.

description.en-US: Recast adds a Save as menu to images and videos on any website. Your rules Pick what to convert from and what to convert to: All videos → Animated WebP, PNG images → AVIF, and so on. Only the rules that match the file you right-clicked appear in the menu. Formats Images: WebP, AVIF, JPEG, PNG Animated: Animated WebP, GIF Video: MP4 (H.264) Quality you can see Each format has a quality slider with a live before/after preview and the resulting file size. The ring next to each menu item shows the quality at a glance. Private Conversion runs inside Firefox using bundled FFmpeg and AVIF encoders. Nothing is uploaded and no data is collected. Notes • Animated WebP and GIF start from where the video is paused and use the clip length you choose (10 s by default). Saved animations have no sound. • MP4 output uses Opus audio. • Streaming videos without a direct file are recorded while they play. Protected (DRM) videos can't be saved.
